capabilities.name: Interactive operation
capabilities.definition: Provides an operator-facing interactive interface for initiating or directing agent work.

capabilities.name: Machine control surface
capabilities.definition: Provides a documented API, SDK, server, or equivalent machine-oriented control surface distinct from terminal UI automation.

capabilities.name: Stable session identity
capabilities.definition: Exposes an identifier that can reliably refer to the same native execution/session context across relevant operations.

capabilities.name: Resume or reconnect
capabilities.definition: Can resume or reconnect to prior native execution state without treating the operation as an unrelated new session.

capabilities.name: Cancellation or interruption
capabilities.definition: Provides a defined mechanism to request or cause interruption of in-progress agent execution, with observable semantics.

capabilities.name: Parallel agent execution
capabilities.definition: Can operate more than one agent session or delegated unit concurrently within the scoped interface or supplied control layer.

capabilities.name: Delegation or handoff
capabilities.definition: Supports attributable transfer or delegation of bounded work to another agent/session/system, natively or through a documented integration.

capabilities.name: Pre-execution gate
capabilities.definition: Provides a control point that can prevent a protected action before the side effect occurs when its conditions are not satisfied.

capabilities.name: Attributed decision
capabilities.definition: Can associate a material allow/deny/approval/review decision with an identifiable principal or decision source.

capabilities.name: Execution isolation boundary
capabilities.definition: Provides a documented technical boundary limiting agent execution access to compute, filesystem, process, or network resources.

capabilities.name: Credential mediation
capabilities.definition: Can supply, scope, broker, or withhold credentials without requiring the model or agent context to receive unrestricted raw secrets.

capabilities.name: Usage reporting
capabilities.definition: Reports measurable execution consumption such as tokens, cost, duration, compute, storage, or external-service use.

capabilities.name: Enforced resource limits
capabilities.definition: Provides a technical mechanism that bounds at least one measurable execution resource or behavior rather than reporting it only after use.

capabilities.name: Operational event export
capabilities.definition: Exposes structured or reconstructable lifecycle/action events that can be retained outside ephemeral conversational state.

capabilities.name: Resolved execution facts
capabilities.definition: Can retain or reconstruct material resolved facts such as model, policy/configuration, environment, artifact, or authority decisions for later explanation.
